title: Things Only We Understand
intro: If someone else saw this, they probably wouldn't understand. But you will.

memories.reveal:
This probably makes absolutely no sense to anyone else. 😂 But that's exactly why I love it.

It's one of those random little things that somehow became ours. Someone else might hear it and think, “What does that even mean?”

But you and I know. And honestly… that's enough. ❤️

Three names. Three different moods. One girl. ❤️

Shrathu. Tanu. Theodron.

To everyone else, they might just sound like random nicknames. But to me, each one carries its own little memory and feeling.

Somewhere along the way, you stopped being just your name… and became all these little names that belong to our world. 🫶🏻

This one deserves its own special place. 😂

Praful Sir beats me when I try to cross your class just to see you.

I wasn't trying to do anything serious… I just wanted to see you. ❤️

And somehow, Praful Sir became the villain of our little love story. 😂

But honestly? Even getting beaten was worth it if it meant getting one little glimpse of you.

finale.title: Our Secret World
finale.text:
Maybe that's the most beautiful thing about us.

We have our own little language. Our own jokes. Our own nicknames. Our own stupid little references. Our own tiny memories that nobody else would understand.

And that's what makes them special.

Love isn't only about the big moments. Sometimes it's about the tiny, ridiculous, completely meaningless things that become priceless simply because they belong to two people.

So if someone else ever opens this page and thinks, “What is all this?”

That's okay. They don't have to understand.

Because this isn't really for them. It's for you. ❤️

Our little world. Our little secrets. Our little memories.

A place where nobody else needs to understand… because you will. ❤️🔐
